The <BIBL> element now contains the whole title correctly.

- '√º' → 'ü' in Teütscher and anzukünden
- '√∂' → 'ö' in Frantzösischer
- '√§' → 'ä' in Majestät
- '√†' → 'à' in "das Stuck à"
- '√ü' → 'ß' in Elßbethen. The encoding error decodes clearly to 'ß', but the original spelling may have been 'Elisabethen', so this word is worth checking against the scan.

I didn't add or rename any other tags. <PRIZE> is left as it is (it may have been meant as PRICE), since it seems to be the project's own label and it already wraps the price correctly."}

I removed the first </TITLE>. The title now covers the whole book description up to "zu sehen ist", which is how titles were usually written in these ads. The <BIBL> element now contains the whole title correctly.

2–7. Garbled characters: some UTF-8 characters had been decoded with the wrong encoding (Mac Roman). I restored them:
- '√º' → 'ü' in Teütscher and anzukünden
- '√∂' → 'ö' in Frantzösischer
- '√§' → 'ä' in Majestät
- '√†' → 'à' in "das Stuck à"
- '√ü' → 'ß' in Elßbethen. The encoding error decodes clearly to 'ß', but the original spelling may have been 'Elisabethen', so this word is worth checking against the scan.

I didn't add or rename any other tags. <PRIZE> is left as it is (it may have been meant as PRICE), since it seems to be the project's own label and it already wraps the price correctly.
